findings.rule: Inspectors record each inspection with queen status and mite counts; a user changed to landowner should lose inspector write privileges.
findings.evidence: A legitimate lead assigned a route to insp2, then changed its role to landowner. myRole returned landowner, but recordInspection on its fresh hive returned HTTP 200/state:sent with queenStatus:queenless, miteCount:9 and inspector set to that demoted account. The lead read back the persisted inspection. Existing route membership bypasses the current-role check (schema.q recordInspection and hives.update). Reproduced twice; script restores the original inspector role.
